# Teach Spectacular Science

> > Comprehensive NGSS-aligned science lessons, units, and classroom resources for middle and high school educators.

Teach Spectacular Science provides ready-to-use, inquiry-based science curriculum covering Earth sciences, chemistry, and environmental topics. Founded by Jessica, the platform offers both free resources and premium materials through its shop, with content designed for classroom implementation and virtual field trips.

## Key Topics

- NGSS-aligned curriculum
- Middle school science
- High school science
- Environmental Science
- Geology
- Meteorology
- Astronomy
- Chemistry
- Inquiry-based learning
- Science lesson plans
- Teacher resources
- Done-for-you materials
- Virtual field trips
- Classroom-tested activities
- Educational worksheets
